description: An extensive network of trails winding through well established second growth forest popular with the mountain biking community and a variety of other user groups. The Snowden Demonstration Forest is a working forest. You will find active harvest development, various silviculture methods, forest research and many recreation opportunities. For your safety, please respect all posted signage.
directions: To Lost Lake parking lot: Follow Hwy 28 toward Gold River for approximately 7kms, turn right on Brewster Bay Rd (just after large Snowden Rec Trails sign) for approximately 3.5 kms going over the dam, left on Loveland Bay Rd (gravel) for approx 4kms and the Lost Lake parking lot is on your right hand side.

stats.Activity Details: Wildlife Viewing, Nature Study, Horseback Riding, Gathering & Collecting, Hiking, Mountain Biking

title: Snowden Trails
